sources.entry: Sublime Text - Text editor with a fast interface and plugin ecosystem. For more plugins, check Sublime Text Plugins. [![Awesome List][awesome-list Icon]](https://github.com/dreikanter/sublime-bookmarks#readme)

summary.name: Sublime Text
summary.one_liner: Sublime Text is a text editor with a fast interface and plugin ecosystem, shown here as the archived Sublime Text 3 download page with its full changelog.
use_cases: reviewing git status and diffs inside the editor
customizing editor themes and color schemes
working with large files and projects
installing plugins to extend the editor
summary.what_it_does: The page is the Sublime Text 3 download page, mainly a changelog from build 3103 (2016) through 3.2.2 (2019). Its features described include Git integration with sidebar status badges and branch/modification info, an incremental diff gutter with diff navigation and revert commands, and a Command Palette with fuzzy matching. Other notes cover theme and color scheme formats, syntax highlighting definitions (.sublime-syntax), ligature support, and High DPI handling. It also mentions a plugin API and Package Control installation.
notable: Git integration with sidebar badges and an incremental diff gutter
Plugin API and Package Control support
Page notes that Sublime Text 4 has been released
caveats: A license must be purchased for continued use after the free evaluation, which has no enforced time limit
This page covers Sublime Text 3, and the page says Sublime Text 4 has since been released with significant improvements
Changelog content runs only to 2019 and is for the older version
